lifecycleRequirements.requirement: provider -> runnerd -> control plane -> runnerd -> provider
one Paperclip-owned sandbox daemon and no TypeScript sandbox dispatcher
canonical catalog consistency and drift rejection
lost ACK, reconnect, runner restart, and provider-thread recovery
interruption while waiting for a tool result
bounded queues, logs, frames, and retries
process-group cleanup with no abandoned provider
assistant transcript capture, token usage, and cost inputs
paperclip_runner is selectable without changing legacy adapter behavior
advertised runner tools re-authorize the live company, issue, agent, and run before using real Paperclip services
Rust runnerd authenticates to the shared Paperclip server route and completes a real bound semantic tool call
real service mutations are replay-safe and reject conflicting idempotency-key reuse
committed PRP reasoning and semantic tool items render in the existing Paperclip task chat
